slug: 2026-01-19 South Sudan introduces digital payment system for passports after supply crisis

facts.fact: National Revenue Authority Commissioner General William Anyuon Kuol said immigration and revenue officials had already been trained to operate the new bank-linked digital passport payment platform.
facts.system: bank-linked digital payment system for passports and national ID
